Subject: Follow-up: Security & pen test items (Tower Labs)

Hi Lena —

Thanks again for taking time earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side related to security & compliance so your procurement/security team can evaluate Redwood: 

- SOC 2: We are in possession of a SOC 2 Type II report for 2025 (completed Q4 2025). I can share the redacted report under an NDA.
- Pen test: We do annual third-party penetration tests and have a summary report available. If you need the full report, we typically provide it under an NDA + Data Processing Addendum.
- Vulnerability management: We run weekly authenticated scans, patch critical findings within 30 days (aim for 14 for critical), and have a formal disclosure/triage SLA.
- Vendor security questionnaire (VSQ): happy to kick off — attaching our standard VSQ and a short pen test summary if helpful.

Proposed next steps:
1) If you can share the questionnaire (or HubSpot link), I’ll route to our security team and get it started.
2) If you need the full pen test or SOC 2 report, we’ll sign an NDA and share securely.
3) Rishi (cc’d) can provide specifics on scanning cadence, remediation SLAs, and our vulnerability disclosure process.

Would love to confirm what level of detail your team needs and any timing constraints for your review.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few items from our side:

- We have an internal checklist: SOC 2 + pen test summary preferred, full pen test under NDA.
- We also require completion of our vendor security questionnaire (I attached it in a separate thread earlier; I can re-send if you don't have it).
- Timing: we’re aiming to complete vendor evaluations by April 16 to make a purchase recommendation for the week of April 19. Is that feasible?
- One ask from our CISO: detail on how you handle critical vulnerabilities discovered in customer-impacting services and average time-to-remediate historically.

If you can share the SOC 2 and pen test summary today and route the VSQ to your security team, that would be great.

Subject: Re: Follow-up: Security & pen test items (Tower Labs)

Hi Lena —

Thanks — attaching the redacted SOC 2 Type II and our high-level pen test summary to this thread. I’ve also uploaded the files to a secure GDrive link (see metadata).

Key answers up front for your CISO:
- Critical vulnerability handling: We immediately create a high-priority incident, notify affected customers per contract, and apply mitigations within 24 hours where possible. Full remediation timelines vary by severity but our SLA for P1/Critical is 14 days to remediation verification.
- Scanning cadence: weekly authenticated scans, daily external monitoring for IOCs, and annual third-party pen test.
- Disclosure: We have a coordinated vulnerability disclosure process and will work with your security team for any joint disclosure.

Rishi — can you add any data points (avg time-to-remediate criticals last 12 months, triage SLA) for Tower Labs?

Best,
Marissa

[Attachment: SOC2_Report_2025.pdf (PDF, redacted, 800KB)]
[Attachment: Redwood_PenTest_Summary_2025.pdf (PDF, 1.1MB)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@towerlabs.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Security & pen test items (Tower Labs)

Marissa / Lena —

Added some specifics you can share with the Tower Labs CISO: 

- Average remediation: For 2025 our internal metrics show average time-to-remediate Critical findings = 9 days, High = 22 days, Medium = 45 days (these are tracked in Jira and validated during audits).
- SLA commitments: We offer contract language for P1/Critical remediations (14-day remediation verification target) and 30-day for most High findings; enterprise customers can opt for accelerated SLAs in Dedicated/Private tiers.
- Scanning cadence & tooling: Weekly authenticated Nessus scans (internal), daily external monitoring via 3rd-party service, and continuous SCA for OSS deps. We also run monthly PR-based SAST for core services.
- Disclosure & coordination: We will sign a coordinated disclosure agreement and can provide a private timeline for responsible disclosure. We redact customer-identifying data in the shared pen test reports.

If Tower would like, we can propose a short mutual action plan: 1) NDA signed by April 6, 2) Redwood returns completed VSQ + SOC2 + pen test summary by April 8, 3) open Q&A with our security team week of April 12, 4) final procurement decision Apr 19.

Happy to jump on a call to walk through the remediation numbers and the report details.

—Rishi
Head of Security | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

[Attachment: Vulnerability_Management_Process_Summary.txt (Plain text, 8KB)]
